gallery.description: The Longluan Lake in Kenting National Park is Taiwan ’s largest natural freshwater lake, it is also an important national wetland announced by the Ministry of the Interior, and it is also a lake with both wetland and reservoir functions.It has long been recognized as an important habitat for overwintering birds.
